bug_locations: sessionize loop: iterate over sorted(events) so (user, timestamp) pairs are ordered per user by time without mutating the input
sessionize session-boundary condition: changed `t - sessions[-1][-1] >= gap` to `> gap`
explanation: Two interacting defects. (1) The events were never sorted, so sessions were built in arrival order rather than by (user, timestamp); using sorted(events) orders each user's timestamps ascending and returns a new list, leaving the input unmutated. (2) The boundary test used `>= gap`, which incorrectly splits a session when the timestamp difference equals gap. The spec starts a new session only when the difference is strictly greater than gap, so the condition must be `> gap` (equivalently, same session when difference <= gap). This makes the visible check (diff 2, gap 2) stay in one session.
